groups.facts: One horizontal slender bar attached at its left end to a vertical fixed support. Support occupies a narrow hatched band to the left of the bar attachment; bar extends right to one free end. Source slight outline skew is uncalibrated print geometry, not a measured taper.

Two solid horizontal force arrows point away from the bar: applied force at the free/right end points right, and the support reaction at the attachment points left. Printed vector labels are F at right and F1 = -F at left. No numerical magnitude, length, scale, axis, dashed line or other subfigure.
